root_cause.text: The TIPC socket implementation allows the connection timeout (`conn_timeout`) to be set to a value less than 4, which causes an integer division by zero during the modulo operation `delay %= (tsk->conn_timeout / 4)` in `tipc_sk_filter_connect()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a check `if (tsk->conn_timeout < 4) tsk->conn_timeout = 4;` in `net/tipc/socket.c` right before the modulo operation `delay %= (tsk->conn_timeout / 4);` to prevent the divisor from becoming zero.
